tasks.behavior: Optional pinned-revision Git verification for document evidence. A working-tree snapshot hash is not Git evidence.
acceptance: diagnose reports snapshotMatches for working-tree hashes and never sets verified true from a hash match alone.
diagnose sets verified true only when evidence.revision is a 40-character Git commit SHA and the blob at revision:path matches evidence.snapshot.
A missing Git repo, branch name, or missing blob keeps verified false.
FEATURES, CAPABILITY, getting-started, and the skill state that a snapshot match is not Git verification.
